about: Every approved version of config/cedar/staff.cedar, oldest first. A change to that file is refused by the build until its hash is the last entry here, proposed by one person and approved by a security approver who is someone else, with the number of sets of facts it opens that the version before refused (crates/channels/tests/staff.rs). staff.approved.cedar holds the version before the last, which the count is measured against.

approved.reason: The policy as first shipped. The approver is a placeholder until a security approver is named.
